round4Clarifications.decision: Treat 'same difficulty' as a measurable effort, purchasing-power and reward-cadence target. Do not claim exact currency parity because the reference is a changing live service and no stable authoritative daily ruby table is public.

Routine high-volume character and weapon pulls should use abundant free tickets. Ruby remains a hard currency for evolution and selected premium or pickup pulls, avoiding a direct mandatory-evolution tax.
Design and validate reward cadence, anticipation, reveal, progress visibility and reset satisfaction. Do not make clinical dopamine claims.

nextAuthorizedAction: Receive the user's Round 4 decisions, then produce one consolidated canonical redline and dependency-closure plan.

referenceBoundary.LegendOfMushroom: Use abundant free-entry draws, multiple acquisition channels, bulk opening and constant visible progress as cadence references. Do not copy UI, names, exact live-service currency amounts, probability tables, rate-level gating, excessive progression verticals or competitive pay pressure.
referenceBoundary.MerchantSaga: Use fast reinvestment, repeated tower climbing and visible maximum-floor gains after reset. Reject intrusive ads and thousands of manual level-up operations.
referenceBoundary.MaouHalfWorld: Use the abstract reset-for-permanent-strength and rapid re-clear pattern. Reject ambiguous loss boundaries and ad-dominant progress.
